args.title: checkout-api v2.3.1 failing health checks; rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: After the latest deploy of checkout-api v2.3.1, the service failed health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an error rate of 18%. Rolled back all regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production (v2.3.1-rc was only verified in staging). After the rollback the service is healthy and the error rate is 0.2%. Next step: find the root cause of the v2.3.1 failure before redeploying.

trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all regions, and it's healthy again. I also opened a SEV2 incident for it.

- **Rollback:** v2.3.1 had been failing health checks in us-east, us-west and eu-west, with an 18% error rate. I rolled all three regions back to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. I skipped v2.3.1-rc because it was only ever healthy in staging, not production.
- **Check afterwards:** All regions are now on v2.3.0, health checks pass, and the error rate is down to 0.2%.
- **Incident:** INC-0001 (SEV2) is open and the on-call engineer has been paged. It describes the failed v2.3.1 deploy, the rollback to v2.3.0 and the recovery numbers. It also notes that someone needs to find out why v2.3.1 failed before it's deployed again.

content.text: Most recent healthy production release is v2.3.0 (v2.3.1-rc was only healthy in staging).
